age.evidence: Male 8-15-week-old C57BL6/J mice were used as the experimental mice for all experiments.

sex.evidence: Male 8-15-week-old C57BL6/J mice were used as the experimental mice for all experiments.

dosing.evidence: mice were administered either 4-F,5-MeO-PyrT (0.1, 0.3, 1 or 3 mg/kg, s.c.)... A separate cohort... receiving a subcutaneous injection of 4-F,5-MeO-PyrT (0.03, 0.1, 0.3, 1 or 3 mg/kg, s.c.)
mice were administered either 4-F,5-MeO-PyrT... or 5-MeO-MET (0.3, 1, 3 or 10 mg/kg, s.c.)

handling.evidence: Methods describe habituation to testing room but do not describe a dedicated handling protocol.

group_housing.evidence: Mice were purchased from the Jackson Laboratory and housed 5 mice per cage with food and water available ad libitum.

assays.assay_description: Locomotor activity measured in clear Plexiglass arena (27.31 x 27.31 x 20.32 cm; Med Associates ENV-510) using infrared beam tracking; 30-min standard session and a separate 120-min cohort. Tested with 4-F,5-MeO-PyrT and 5-MeO-MET +/- WAY-100635 pretreatment, also in a chronic social defeat sub-cohort.

application_type.evidence: 4-F,5-MeO-PyrT (0.1, 0.3, 1 or 3 mg/kg, s.c.) or 5-MeO-MET (0.3, 1, 3 or 10 mg/kg, s.c.)

setup_habituation.evidence: mice were allowed to habituate for 30 min [to the testing room]; no separate apparatus habituation described.

setup_restrain.evidence: allowed to ambulate freely for 30 min

food_restriction.evidence: Standard Plexiglass open field arena; no food in apparatus.

water_restriction.evidence: Standard Plexiglass open field arena; no water in apparatus.

time_to_assay.evidence: immediately gently placed in a clear Plexiglass arena... after receiving a subcutaneous injection

sample_size.evidence: Evaluation of 4-F,5-MeO-PyrT in open field for two hours (n = 3-4/group); Effect of WAY-100635... on total locomotion (n = 7-8/group, 30 min)

outcomes.summary: Both 4-F,5-MeO-PyrT and 5-MeO-MET produced dose-dependent suppression of locomotor activity in the open field, consistent with 5-HT1A-mediated sedation. The locomotor-suppressing effect was attenuated by WAY-100635 pretreatment.
outcomes.statistics: one-way ANOVA with Tukey's post hoc test; exact p values reported in figure panels
outcomes.evidence: We observed dose-dependent locomotor suppression in the open-field test for both 4-F,5-MeO-PyrT and 5-MeO-MET

B1_num_measures.evidence: ambulatory distance traveled... total locomotion... corner time as a measure of anxiety-like behavior

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Total locomotion reported across session; no within-session time-bin analysis described.

B3_sequential_structure.evidence: No transition or sequence analysis reported.

B4_ethological.evidence: Measures locomotor distance and zone occupancy via beam breaks; no ethological act scoring.

B5_social.evidence: Animals tested alone in open field.

B7_automated_classification.evidence: Data were collected using Activity Monitor by Med Associates (infrared beam-break system).

E1_environment_type.evidence: clear Plexiglass arena (27.31 x 27.31 x 20.32 cm, Med Associates ENV-510)

E6_spatial.evidence: Standard square open field with no internal compartments.

D1_continuity.evidence: Single recording session per animal (30 min or 120 min).

D2_session_duration.evidence: A separate cohort... allowed to ambulate freely for 120 min

D5_followup.evidence: Recording starts immediately post-injection; no >=24h follow-up.

assays.assay_description: Mice placed in a new observation cage immediately after s.c. injection; HTR scored from overhead GoPro video (120 Hz) for the first 10 min. Tested with 4-F,5-MeO-PyrT and 5-MeO-MET +/- WAY-100635 pretreatment.

application_type.evidence: mice were administered either 4-F,5-MeO-PyrT... or 5-MeO-MET... s.c.

setup_habituation.evidence: Mice were habituated to the testing room for 30 min; no apparatus habituation described.

setup_restrain.evidence: placed in a new observation cage

food_restriction.evidence: Observation cage during recording; no food.

water_restriction.evidence: Observation cage during recording; no water.

time_to_assay.evidence: mice were administered... and placed in a new observation cage. An overhead camera... recorded their movements.

outcomes.summary: 5-MeO-MET produced strong dose-dependent HTR, especially with WAY-100635 co-administration (5-HT1A blockade unmasks 5-HT2A-driven HTR). 4-F,5-MeO-PyrT did not produce notable HTR at doses up to 3 mg/kg, consistent with its 5-HT1A selectivity and lack of 5-HT2A engagement in vivo.
outcomes.statistics: one-way ANOVA with Tukey's post hoc test; exact p values in figure
outcomes.evidence: 5-MeO-MET showed strong dose-dependent activity following co-administration of the 5-HT1A-selective antagonist WAY-100635... By contrast, 4-F,5-MeO-PyrT did not produce notable HTR at doses up to 3 mg/kg

B1_num_measures.evidence: Observers scored HTR from recorded footage for the first 10-min period.

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Total HTR count across 10 min reported.

B4_ethological.evidence: HTR is explicitly defined in the rubric as not ethological.

B7_automated_classification.evidence: Observers scored HTR from recorded footage (manual scoring).

E1_environment_type.evidence: placed in a new observation cage

E3_bedding.evidence: Bedding not reported in observation cage.

D2_session_duration.evidence: scored HTR... for the first 10-min period

assays.assay_description: Chronic social defeat (10 days) followed 24 h post-drug by two-phase SI test: 2.5 min no-target exploration of open arena, then 2.5 min with a novel CD-1 in a wire mesh cage. Time in interaction zone and corners tracked by EthoVision. Tested with vehicle, 4-F,5-MeO-PyrT (1 mg/kg s.c.), WAY-100635, and combination.

application_type.evidence: mice were injected with 4-F,5-MeO-PyrT (1.0 mg/kg) or vehicle

setup_habituation.evidence: No habituation to the SI arena is described prior to the test.

setup_restrain.evidence: experimental mouse is allowed to explore an open-field arena

food_restriction.evidence: No food in the SI arena.

water_restriction.evidence: No water in the SI arena.

time_to_assay.evidence: mice were injected with 4-F,5-MeO-PyrT (1.0 mg/kg) or vehicle and evaluated in the SI test 24 h later.

sample_size.evidence: A total of 46 mice were administered vehicle treatment (17 control, 29 stress), 53 received 4-F,5-MeO-PyrT (17 control, 36 stress), 15 received WAY-100635 (5 control, 10 stress), and 29 received 4-F,5-MeO-PyrT + WAY-100635 (10 control, 19 stress).

outcomes.summary: Chronic social defeat reduced the social interaction ratio in vehicle-treated mice; 4-F,5-MeO-PyrT (1 mg/kg s.c., 24 h pre-test) rescued this deficit and increased the proportion of resilient mice. Co-administration of WAY-100635 blocked the effect, indicating 5-HT1A mediation. Defeated vehicle mice also spent more time in corners; drug treatment normalized this.
outcomes.statistics: two-way ANOVA: interaction P = 0.1778; row (treatment) P = 0.0741; column (control/stress) P = 0.0001; Fisher's LSD post hoc; Fisher's exact test for resilient/susceptible proportions
outcomes.evidence: This phenotype was rescued by 4-F,5-MeO-PyrT treatment, as indicated by an increased IR in the stress-exposed mice... WAY-100635 co-administration blocked the ability of 4-F,5-MeO-PyrT to ameliorate SI deficits

B1_num_measures.evidence: time in interaction zone (no-target and target), interaction ratio, time in corners, locomotor distance during no-target session

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Summary measures averaged across each 2.5-min phase.

B4_ethological.evidence: Time-in-zone measures only, not ethological act scoring.

B5_social.evidence: a new CD-1 male mouse is placed into a wire mesh cage

B7_automated_classification.evidence: automatically tracked using EthoVision analysis software (Noldus)

B8_multivariate.evidence: No multivariate analysis; resilient/susceptible split is a univariate threshold.

E1_environment_type.evidence: open-field arena with wire mesh cage on one side

E5_enrichment.evidence: No enrichment objects (wire mesh cage with CD-1 is the test stimulus).

E6_spatial.evidence: Single open arena with virtual interaction and corner zones (no physical partitions).

E7_social_context.evidence: a new CD-1 male mouse is placed into a wire mesh cage

D1_continuity.evidence: Two-session test: no-target phase (2.5 min) and target phase (2.5 min) with data reported for both.

D3_recording_days.evidence: SI test conducted on day 11 only.

D4_baseline.evidence: No-target phase is part of same session, not a pre-drug baseline; drug already on board.

D5_followup.evidence: evaluated in the SI test 24 h later [after drug administration]

assays.assay_description: Two-bottle choice (water vs 1% sucrose) in home cage with ad libitum overnight access, conducted after SI test in chronic social defeat mice. Tested with vehicle, 4-F,5-MeO-PyrT, WAY-100635, and combination.

application_type.evidence: mice were injected with 4-F,5-MeO-PyrT (1.0 mg/kg) or vehicle

setup_habituation.evidence: On day 10, chronic SD stressed mice were individually housed and habituated to two bottles containing just water.

setup_restrain.evidence: Mice had ad libitum overnight access to both bottles.

food_restriction.evidence: Mice had ad libitum overnight access to both bottles (in home cage).

water_restriction.evidence: Mice had ad libitum overnight access to both bottles.

time_to_assay.evidence: Twenty-four hours later, following the SI test, one bottle was replaced with a 1% sucrose solution

sample_size.evidence: A total of 27 mice were administered vehicle (9 control, 18 stress), 27 received 4-F,5-MeO-PyrT (9 control, 18 stress), 15 received WAY-100635 (5 control, 10 stress), and 15 received 4-F,5-MeO-PyrT + WAY-100635 (5 control, 10 stress).

outcomes.summary: Chronic social defeat reduced sucrose preference in vehicle-treated mice (anhedonia). 4-F,5-MeO-PyrT (1 mg/kg s.c.) restored sucrose preference to control-like levels in stressed mice, an effect blocked by WAY-100635, indicating 5-HT1A mediation.
outcomes.statistics: two-way ANOVA: interaction P = 0.0773; row (treatment) P = 0.0159; column (control/stress) P = 0.0008; Fisher's LSD post hoc
outcomes.evidence: stressed mice treated with 4-F,5-MeO-PyrT had significantly increased sucrose preference relative to vehicle-treated animals... co-administration of WAY-100635 reversed the effects of 4-F,5-MeO-PyrT

B1_num_measures.evidence: preference for sucrose over water was calculated as follows: (sucrose/(sucrose + water)) × 100

E1_environment_type.evidence: chronic SD stressed mice were individually housed and habituated to two bottles

E2_shelter.evidence: No shelter reported in test cage.

E3_bedding.evidence: Not explicitly reported for the test cage.

E8_food_water.evidence: Mice had ad libitum overnight access to both bottles

D2_session_duration.evidence: Mice had ad libitum overnight access to both bottles

D4_baseline.evidence: Habituation to two water bottles was not used as a reported preference baseline.

D5_followup.evidence: Test conducted ~24 h or more after drug administration (following the 24-h post-injection SI test).

D6_circadian.evidence: ad libitum overnight access to both bottles (>=6 h continuous measurement)

judge_notes: Both candidates identified the same four behavioural assays (OFT, HTR, SI test, sucrose preference); no merging or dropping required.
B1 for OFT set to 2-3 (score 1): paper reports locomotor distance plus corner time in the SD sub-cohort (Extended Data Fig. 7e-g).
B1 for SI scored 4-6 (2 pts) reflecting no-target time, target time, interaction ratio, corner time, and locomotion measures.
D1 for SI raised to 'Multiple discrete sessions' (1 pt) because both no-target and target phases are recorded and reported as distinct sessions within the test.
D6 for sucrose preference set to Yes (overnight >=6 h continuous monitoring), correcting the GLM candidate.
D2 for OFT set to 61 min–6 h (2 pts) because a 120-min cohort was explicitly run, matching the longest single session rule.
setup_habituation for OFT and HTR set to 'no'/'not_reported' rather than 'yes' since the paper describes room habituation only, which the rubric explicitly excludes from setup habituation.
B7 scored 0 across all assays: EthoVision and Med Associates Activity Monitor are position-tracking systems per rubric; HTR was scored manually.
